summary: Flat kerb on Waverley Road where cars park, but homes sit close on both sides.

best_section.where: Waverley Road north kerb, under the trees about a quarter of the way along

drivers.seclusion: Houses and flats line both sides; nearest mapped dwellings 11 m at 20 m and 45 m along, 24 m at 36 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane with cars parked in it; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a junction at the far end; steady passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van would blend in.

flags: Steep overall: mean 10.5%, max 15.6%; only 25-37 m is near level
sun_shade: Trees shade the verge on the north side; sun from the south side and overhead at midday.
